SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow corpses with implants
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow dead bodies that still hold an implant worth salvaging. Untick this on a crematorium or butcher table bill to stop it destroying bionics, or on a stockpile to keep implanted bodies out of it.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow corpses without implants
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow dead bodies with nothing left worth pulling out. Untick this on a stockpile to make it a salvage pile that only accepts bodies still carrying an implant.
